text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm leaving to go out on my day off, I
come
across Special Week in her
tracksuit.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh! Hiiiii, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Nope. I'm going to play tennis with
Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've never played tennis before, so I'm
really
excited... and a bit nervous!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Do you wanna come and watch?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I'm not going to be doing
anything
impressive, but it'll be worth
coming just to see
Maruzen since she's
so good!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to accept Special Week's
invitation and
watch their tennis match.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay, darlings! Time to get our heart
rates up
and sweat flowing!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: All right!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I'm ready! I can't believe I get to play
tennis with
you, Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-I'm gonna do my best too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Aw, you don't have to be so nervous! It's
all cool
beans! Come on, Spe. Let's pair
up! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Pair up? Y-you mean like be on the same
team?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's important for the two people pairing
up to
trust each other.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I trust you, so I'm not worried about
anything.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I trust you too, so I'm not worried either!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now then, we need a player in the front
and
another in the back. Which position
do you
prefer?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The front player needs quick reflexes,
while the
back player needs stamina
since they have to
guard a wide area.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Speed or stamina... Hmm, which suits me
better?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. Do you think I'd be better
playing
at the front or the back?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Aw, thanks for having so much faith in
me! Okay,
front position it is!
choice_data_list: 反応の良さを信じて前衛！
スタミナを信じて後衛！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All right, time to do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begins the game of tennis.
However...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Reflexes up in front, lightning-fast
reflexes...
Raaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smack.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Spe... Your reflexes are the bee's knees,
but you
should hit the ball with your
racket—not your
face.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... I know, but I'm just not used to
swinging
the racket...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week's reflexes continue to
improve, but
the same can't be said for
her tennis skills.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The back position? Got it! I used to run
around
the meadows back home all the
time, so I know
I've got stamina!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begins the game of tennis.
However...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen's been carrying the whole
game, so I
gotta return the favor by
dishing out a good
serve!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Here I go... Hah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smack.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week's serve nails Maruzensky
squarely
on the back of her head.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Gaaah! I'm so, so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I expected that to happen sooner or
later.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Those aren't the kinds of expectations I
want you
to have!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Special Week runs her heart
out in the
back, perhaps to atone for her
foul serve.
